name: SUPREME multi-method sampler
plain: A configurable loop: pick a step method per substep (euler, dpm_1s/2s/3s, rk4, reversible Heun, RKF45, Bogacki-Shampine, trapezoidal, RES, dynamic or adaptive order), plus denoised enhancements and noise modulation. It averages substep results with weights. It auto-disables noise on flow schedules.
math:
For each σᵢ, k substeps: z_k from x, step by selected method, z_avg += w_k z_k, then optionally re-noise. x=z_avg + noise_mod(σ↑).
dynamic/adaptive_rk pick order from an error of x0 vs previous (thresholds 3.75e-2, 7.5e-2, 1.5e-1). Weights table: {1:[1],2:[½,½],3:[⅙,⅔,⅙],4:[⅛,⅜,⅜,⅛]}.
Denoised enhancements: bilateral blur + unsharp edge term scaled by (σᵢ−σᵢ₊₁), channel centralize and normalize, perpendicular addition of previous x0. Noise modulation: none, intensity, frequency, spectral_signum.
If σ_max ≤ 1.001: η=0, s_noise=0, modulation none.
